artifacts.description: Input snapshot bound to the discovery certificate.
Business rule with explicit enforcement trace.
Use case covering one or more FRs.
Acceptance criteria represented as contract data.
Architecture and decomposition contract created after baseline freeze.
Authoritative result of the Formalization process.

nodes.label: Resolve Product Contract

nodes.label: Model Use Cases

nodes.label: Resolve Use Cases

nodes.label: Freeze Acceptance Baseline

identity.description: Converts an accepted discovery subject into a frozen, traceable and implementable solution contract.
identity.name: solution-formalization

invariants.description: PRD, FR, NFR, RULE, UC and AC are reconciled and frozen before SRS.
Every accepted artifact has its required derived_from, covers or enforced_by links.
Accepted AC baseline cannot be edited in place.
Process, node, task, execution, artifact and schema identities are machine-filled.
Every LM node maintains an external tracker and restart checkpoint.
Artifact, trace and completion MCP calls are materialized and checklist-verified.
The module returns a local outcome and never starts Development directly.

outcomes.description: A complete frozen solution contract is ready for downstream work.
Required product or acceptance information is missing.
The contract graph contains unresolved contradictions or traceability gaps.
The requested solution cannot be implemented under the accepted constraints.
Formalization infrastructure could not produce an authoritative result.

policies.description: Requires complete WHAT-side traceability before baseline freeze.
Validates the frozen acceptance and architecture graph before certification.
